posts.excerpt: GitHub Copilot just hit 60 million+ PR reviews. Insane growth. They also moved to an agentic architecture - it reads repo context now, not just the diff. But here's the thing most people miss: most code reviewers do the same thing Copilot used to do. They review the change. Not the system the change is breaking.
